The three recorded 1999 events accurately describe (a) the additional preamble law at the same anchor, (b) expansion of the first delegated-functions sentence, and (c) the additional FAA functions inserted into the second sentence created by EO 13028 section 1(b)(3). EO 13345 section 6(c) subsequently and unconditionally revokes the order, without savings or postponement, so July 8, 2004 first ends and whole-order end remain supported. All three assembled later-event sources exactly reproduce held ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13131, with matching text hashes.
